# Apple Game Porting Toolkit 4.0 beta 3

The `redist/lib` folder of the "Evaluation environment for Windows games 4.0 beta 3" image in Apple's
[Game Porting Toolkit](https://developer.apple.com/games/game-porting-toolkit/), unmodified, with
Apple's signatures and notices. It is the D3DMetal that SiliconBedrock was tested with.

**This folder isn't under the GPL.** [`License.rtf`](License.rtf) is Apple's license, and it applies to
everything here. It allows distribution for non-commercial purposes only, and use for developing,
testing or evaluating video games on Apple-branded products. Read it before you use or pass on these
files.

[`Acknowledgements.rtf`](Acknowledgements.rtf) and [`Read Me.rtf`](<Read Me.rtf>) are Apple's as well.

The app checks Apple's signatures on D3DMetal and `libd3dshared` before every session.
